title: platform.yaml
description: App manifest for the shirtracer platform (specs/007-app-contract data-model §1, specs/008-platform-controller data-model §5).

name.description: App name: lower-case letters and digits, starting with a letter, at most 31 characters, no '-'. Names the route, database, Redis user, buckets and services.

domain.description: Defaults to the app name (https://<name>.apps.<platform domain>). Any other value must be a full domain allowlisted for this app by the platform admin.

auth.description: forward: the platform login runs before every request. oidc: the app logs users in with its own OIDC client of the platform. none: no platform login (public, or the app's own authentication).

access.description: Who may use the app behind the platform login (required with auth forward or oidc, not allowed with none). Groups named <name>-<suffix> are created by the platform and owned by the app; other names must be existing groups and grant access only.

groups.description: Groups whose members may use the app; <name>-* groups are created, others must exist.

managers.description: Existing platform usernames that manage the members of the app's own <name>-* groups in the Authentik UI; no other rights.

auth_callbacks.description: Only with auth oidc: extra redirect paths on the app's own host, besides /oauth2/callback; paths only, no '..'.

services.description: Shared services the app uses. Removing one revokes access and keeps the data.

postgres.description: A database <name> owned by the app's role.

extensions.description: Extensions from the platform's allowlist; removing one never drops it.

redis.description: An ACL user <name> for keys and channels under <name>:.

s3.description: The bucket <name>; the app may create and delete buckets <name>-*.

secrets.description: Names of the app's own secrets; values come from the repo's GitHub Environment.

rollback.description: Roll back to the last healthy version when a deploy does not become healthy (default true).
